current_verification_scope: The supplied independent review was read in full against the current v0.16.0 manuscript and the user’s governing wording. The revision develops the connected appeal rather than only a comparison of two answers. Root and the two existing requested Sol 6.1 Max advisers assessed the actual revised text; manuscript reconstruction preceded their fidelity comparison. Both first passes challenged the inference from a religious account to independent answer provision. The revised reply distinguishes experience selecting exercises from experience commending the religious account itself, and preserves the general-authorisation alternative and its precise defeat point. Bounded companion review checked consistency; source-interpretation limits remain explicit. Adviser agreement is not primary evidence or proof. Existing extracts reread for Big Book pp46-50, 59-60 and93-94, 12&12 Step Three pp35 and39-40, Step Eleven pp102-104, Asfahani pp36-37, and El-Tobgui pp165-166. Prior source identities and verification limits retained. No new primary source, complete-book reading, independent Arabic collation, clinical comparison or consensus judgement is claimed. Reader tests and publication checks establish technical properties, not substantive validity.
edition_scope: The governing criticism is AA operating on the unavailability of definitive divine direction as the answer while directing the person to seek God for the remedy. The manuscript examines its method of identifying approach, surrender and restoration, argues why instruction as the definitive governing answer is unavailable within that operation, and explains why the appeal exposes this very unavailable kind of answer as what is sought. The grounding test examines genuine delivery or substitution within the appeal; a comparison of competing solutions, room for a human answer, missing warrant or a later veto does not replace the inquiry. The practical-execution objection is tested at the whole-course inference; conditional premises and the separate affirmative Islamic argument remain explicit. Wording analysis examines the same operation beneath the presentation of openness. Prior research, positive Islamic content, scope boundaries, Millati removal and reader pipeline are preserved.
